text_to_image_prompt:
Create ONE landscape 3:2 full-body turnaround sheet: exactly THREE equal-size head-to-toe figures of the SAME character and costume, left strict FRONT, center strict 90-degree SIDE facing right, right strict BACK. All at same scale, height and foot baseline, all hair and footwear visible, arms naturally down. No extra portraits or panels. Character-specific body: 187 cm, visibly athletic upper body, long muscular legs. Approximately 8.0 to 8.2 anatomical heads tall from skull crown (exclude tall hair, crown, ears and hat) to soles. Long elegant legs and arms, natural normal neck, proportionate head; do not fake height with heels, tiny shrunken head, stretched neck or camera distortion. Different characters retain distinctive builds. Full outfit: Same white beanie and sleeveless heavyweight white shirt, charcoal loose athletic trousers with a clean long fall, white chunky training sneakers.
Premium semi-realistic dimensional 3D character CG: finely sculpted face, delicate luminous skin microtexture, soft subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, individual wispy hair strands, detailed fabric and metal. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with balanced fill, subtle contact shadow. No text, labels, watermark, frame or collage borders. Preserve original age, facial anatomy, ethnicity, hair, eyes and accessories.
Character design: Male age 25, fit with athletic shoulders. White ribbed beanie with a single small dark metal tab, short black textured fringe visible. Dusty violet deep-set eyes, diamond-shaped face, broad cheekbones, short rounded-square chin, strong straight nose, flat thick brows, full relaxed lips. Neutral ivory skin. Crisp white sleeveless heavyweight cotton top with subtle rib collar. Playful calm confidence; arms down, hands absent.
reproduction_note: 此为带身份参考图生成的补充素材；独立文字提示词已重建，未经纯文生图复现验证。严格同脸请同时使用身份母版。
